entries.title: Joshua 3:1
segments: They who are earnest, diligent, and persevering in the discharge of their appropriate duties, may expect to be rendered eminently useful, and advanced to distinguished honor and glory.

entries.title: Joshua 3:2
segments: After three days; from the time mentioned in

entries.title: Joshua 3:3
segments: To follow the directions of God as indicated by his word, his Spirit, and his providence, is the way of safety, happiness, and success.

entries.title: Joshua 3:4
segments: Two thousand cubits; about one thousand yards, or two thirds of a mile.

entries.title: Joshua 3:5
segments: Sanctification of body and spirit is a preparation for seeing the glory of God, and experiencing the manifestations of his power and grace.

entries.title: Joshua 3:7
segments: Magnify thee; show by miracle that he had appointed Joshua, and clothed him with authority as the leader of Israel.

entries.title: Joshua 3:10
segments: Hereby; by what he would do in dividing the waters of Jordan.
However dark the path before us, God can make it plain; and however great the difficulties in the way of duty, he can remove them, and cause us in obeying him to triumph.

entries.title: Joshua 3:12
segments: Twelve men; these were to be selected for a special purpose.

entries.title: Joshua 3:13
segments: Be cut off; the waters below would separate from the waters above, leaving the channel of the river dry.
Multitudes of things which are impossible with men are possible with God.  It is therefore reasonable and a duty to believe whatever he declares, and show that belief by our conduct.

entries.title: Joshua 3:15
segments: The time of harvest; the people crossed on the tenth of the first month Abib, or early in April.
Then, as now, the harvest occurred during April and early in May, the barley preceding the wheat harvest by two or three weeks.

entries.title: Joshua 3:16
segments: Whatever difficulties may be in the way of believing God, living and strong faith will overcome them; and those who exercise it will in due time see the complete fulfilment of his declarations.
